pairs: and the honor of that eternal glory,
God will surround you with a double garment of justice,
et imponet mitram capiti honoris æterni.
and he will set a crown on your head of everlasting honor.
Deus enim ostendet splendorem suum in te, omni qui sub cælo est.
For God will reveal his splendor in you to all who are under heaven.
Nominabitur enim tibi nomen tuum a Deo in sempiternum:
For your name will be given to you by God for eternity:
and look around towards the east,
et vide collectos filios tuos ab oriente sole usque ad occidentem,
and see your sons, gathering together, from the rising of the sun to the setting of the sun,
by the word of the Holy One,
rejoicing in the remembrance of God.
Exierunt enim abs te pedibus ducti ab inimicis:
For they went out from you on foot, led by the enemies,
adducet autem illos Dominus ad te portatos in honore sicut filios regni:
but the Lord will lead them to you, being carried in honor like sons of the kingdom.
constituit enim Deus humiliare omnem montem excelsum et rupes perennes,
For God has resolved to humble every high mountain and the longstanding cliffs,
et convalles replere in æqualitatem terræ,
and to fill up the steep valleys in order to level the ground,
ut ambulet Israël diligenter in honorem Dei.
so that Israel may walk diligently in the honor of God.
et omne lignum suavitatis Israël ex mandato Dei.
and every sweet-smelling tree have provided shade for Israel by the commandment of God.
Adducet enim Deus Israël cum jucunditate in lumine majestatis suæ,
For God will lead Israel with joy into the light of his majesty,
et justitia quæ est ex ipso.
